visual_action: A short, shaky, very close-up video shows Donald Trump's face. He appears to be in a crowd of people, with another person's face partially visible behind him. The camera angle is low and distorted, and the video loops.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the person shown in the close-up video, and the on-screen text, which refers to 'this man' and 'the presidency', is about him.

on_screen_text.text: This man does not care about you. He just reported $600M in income. He's literally using the presidency to farm crypto money

spoken_summary: There is no speaking in the video, only music.
audio_music: The upbeat pop song 'Your Love Is My Drug' by Ke$ha plays throughout the clip. The cheerful, romantic tone of the song creates an ironic or mocking contrast with the critical on-screen text and unflattering visuals.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, short, shaky, handheld-style clip with no cuts.
cultural_references: The song 'Your Love Is My Drug' by Ke$ha.
central_claim: Donald Trump is corruptly using his political position to enrich himself via cryptocurrency and does not care about the public.
intended_effect: To generate anger and distrust towards Donald Trump by portraying him as corrupt and self-serving.
